To get the best results and make your Skylar scent last, here are some tips! ✨

Apply to Pulse Points: Your wrists, neck, behind the ears, chest, and even behind your knees are great spots. The warmth helps the scent radiate.
Moisturize First: Apply an unscented lotion to your pulse points after a shower. This helps the fragrance anchor to your skin.
Tap, Don't Rub: After spritzing, gently tap your wrists together instead of rubbing, as rubbing can break down the scent notes.
Hair & Clothes: For extra longevity, spray a little on your fingers and run through your hair, or spritz into the air and walk through the mist to scent your clothes.
Layering: Skylar scents are designed to be layered! Apply your anchoring scent first, then add a complementary scent on top. The scent you want to have the most impact should go on last.

You can find more details on extending your scent's wear here and on layering here. 🌸
